terra.problem: The text does not say that all the riches, wealth and honor stay his. It says a stranger will enjoy them.
The explanation says the child is better off if the man is unsatisfied, omitting the comparison's additional condition that he does not receive a proper burial.
The comparison omits the man's lack of a proper burial. It also attributes an intention to the Teacher by saying he means the line to be hard.
The bakery comparison does not match an appetite remaining unsatisfied. Someone walking in smelling the oven does not explain why Papa would feel done or why more work would follow.
The explanation assigns the Teacher a reason for asking the question that the text does not give.
